opening.argument: The presentation promotes Forsage as a way to make money online “on complete autopilot,” directs viewers to a description link to get started, and sets a minimum entry payment of .05 ETH. Participation is tied to recruiting partners: “when you invite partners, they're gonna places under you,” while payments are distributed through sponsor-linked positions and repeated level-one re-entry. The X3 and X4 structures organize partners into successive levels, and continued earning is expressly conditioned on inviting new members. The speaker also predicts that partners will follow into multiple paid levels. The income disclaimer limits conclusions about actual results, but it does not remove the described recruit-linked payment mechanism.
